review_notes: I read the whole file and the definitions of mapPt, mapPt_coe, pushPt and FactorsThrough in Definitions/Def_CerednikDrinfeld_QMModuli.lean. The simp interface is small. `img_coe` is a rfl projection lemma marked `@[scoped simp]`, and its left side `(img hg P).1` rewrites to `P.1 ≫ g`. That orientation is right, it can't cycle, and it works together with the existing `@[simp] mapPt_coe`. The proofs use `simp only [img_coe, mapPt_coe, Category.assoc, hcomm]`, which gives the intended normal form. `pushPt` is an abbrev for `mapPt`, so listing it in `simp only` is redundant but harmless. `img_one`, `img_mul` and `eq_one_iff` take a non-trivial `hg_mul` hypothesis and mention the explicit `hg`, `L` and `L'`. Making them simp lemmas would add side conditions that simp can't discharge, so leaving them unannotated is sound. The `rw [timg, …]` steps in the main theorem are local and I see no case for a global simp lemma there. I did not run Lean. I did not check the other files that use `ALBaseChange`. I found no justified simp-interface defect.
